fieldNotes.locationProblem: Roster gave no street address and an APPROXIMATE geocode. Web search (The Registry, Crexi, Syndicated Equities, Neagley+Chase) places the facility at 458 Second Avenue, Burbank, WA — a NEWLY CONSTRUCTED ~107,200 sq ft pre-engineered-metal-building (PEMB) Frito-Lay distribution warehouse, listed for sale in early 2024.
fieldNotes.imageryGap: The address '458 Second Avenue' could not be geocoded to a precise rooftop. Probing the Burbank industrial park near the US-12/SR-124 interchange found: (a) the 'Precision' building (confirmed NOT Frito-Lay via its rooftop sign in 2026 Street View), (b) several unbranded smaller warehouses, and (c) multiple still-vacant lots. Current Maxar/USDA-FPAC satellite imagery appears to PREDATE the completed Frito-Lay DC — no ~107k sq ft building matching the listing, and no Frito-Lay-branded structure, could be positively identified.
fieldNotes.classification: Because the exact building could not be confirmed, all classification fields are best-guess defaults (no-gate / no docks) and ALL are flagged uncertain. A Frito-Lay regional DC of ~107k sq ft would typically have a substantial dock bank, a trailer yard, and likely a fenced/gated truck entry — none of which could be verified.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Burbank, WA is a small unincorporated community; the industrial park sits at the edge of town near farmland and a highway interchange — Rural.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Flag for human review and a fresh imagery pass once newer satellite covering the completed 458 Second Ave building is available.
